long_biography.plain_text:
Revival of Maritime Traditions is an institutional identity rather than a person. Its full legal name is Association (Non-Profit Partnership) Revival of Maritime Traditions, and it carries Russian tax number 7805303650 and registration number 1097800006380. The association was registered in 2009 and has its registered office in Saint Petersburg.

Its registered main activity is market and public-opinion research. Additional filed activities span publishing, databases, management consulting and marine transport services. This legal and activity profile establishes a distinct nonprofit association with a broad registered scope; it does not identify a natural person or support person-level wealth attributes.
